create_terminal_action_wrapper: create a CommandlineWithTerminalAction wrapper that adds an end-of-episode terminal action to a CompilerEnv
run_multistep_with_terminal: run multistep on a CommandlineWithTerminalAction wrapper to execute actions until the terminal action is reached
create_constrained_commandline_wrapper: create a ConstrainedCommandline wrapper that restricts a CompilerEnv action space to a subset of flags
translate_constrained_actions: translate actions between constrained and original action spaces using forward and reverse translation
fork_constrained_environment: fork a ConstrainedCommandline wrapper to create an independent copy with the same constrained flags
